_doc: Everything the organization decides, in one file. Edit it in the kit repository (merge request), then each workstation runs update. See docs/customization.md.
_people_doc: email -> {"profile": "<profile id>", "team": "<team id>"}: suggested by setup; the team selects practices/20-<team>.md. Keep the list minimal.
_defaults_doc: Organization defaults (same keys as ~/.ai-kit/overrides.json: code_assist, vertex, model, models, hooks, mcp, extra_skills, disabled_commands, frictions...). Each person's overrides.json is applied on top: lists add up, objects combine, the person's value wins for a single value.
